# CrossChainReceiverBase
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/chain-bridge/src/base/CrossChainReceiverBase.sol)

**Inherits:**
[ICrossChainReceiver](../interfaces/i-cross-chain-receiver.md)

**Title:**
CrossChainReceiverBase

Base contract for implementing cross-chain operation receivers

Provides unified receiveOperation method that decodes operation types and delegates to internal handlers


## Functions
### receiveOperation

Receives and routes cross-chain operations to appropriate handlers

This is the unified entry point for all cross-chain operations


```solidity
function receiveOperation(
    BridgeTypes.OperationType operationType,
    bytes calldata encodedParams
)
    external
    virtual
    override;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`operationType`|`BridgeTypes.OperationType`|The type of operation being delivered|
|`encodedParams`|`bytes`|Encoded operation parameters|


### getSupportedOperationTypes

Returns the operation types supported by this receiver

This allows callers to discover what operations this receiver can handle


```solidity
function getSupportedOperationTypes()
    external
    view
    virtual
    override
    returns (BridgeTypes.OperationType[] memory supportedTypes);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`supportedTypes`|`BridgeTypes.OperationType[]`|Array of supported operation types|


### supportsInterface

Checks if the contract supports a given interface ID


```solidity
function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) external pure virtual override returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`interfaceId`|`bytes4`|The interface ID to check|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|True if the contract supports the interface, false otherwise|

### _requireAuthorizedCaller

Validates that the caller is authorized to call receiveOperation

Must be implemented by derived contracts to enforce access control


```solidity
function _requireAuthorizedCaller() internal view virtual;
```
